intent: Build a class LRUCache(capacity) implementing a least-recently-used cache. get(key) returns the stored value for key if present (and marks key as most-recently-used), else returns -1. put(key, value) inserts or updates the value for key (marks it as most-recently-used). If inserting a NEW key would make the cache exceed capacity, evict the LEAST-recently-used key first before inserting. capacity is a positive integer >= 1.
oracle_test:
from lrucache import LRUCache


def test_oracle():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put(1, 'a')
    c.put(2, 'b')
    assert c.get(1) == 'a'
    c.put(3, 'c')
    assert c.get(2) == -1
    assert c.get(1) == 'a'
    assert c.get(3) == 'c'
    c.put(4, 'd')
    assert c.get(1) == -1
    assert c.get(3) == 'c'
    assert c.get(4) == 'd'
